sourceSentences: [0] c'est un sort qui se sépare. Qu'est-ce que ça veut dire ? Ça veut dire que s'il y a plusieurs targets donc dans la zone qui est ici, bah ça va séparer le queue. Donc forcément, il fera moins de dégâts.
[0] Un queue isolé par exemple ici, voilà, fera beaucoup moins de dégâts qu'un queue forcément séparé puisque ça split les missiles.
[0] Et donc forcément un que isolé à ce moment-là fera énormément de dégâts puisque bah il y aura 12 missiles sur une seule personne.
[0] Donc le Z c'est un missile qui a plus une range bah franchement assez grande, on va pas se mentir. Euh voilà et ça va tout simplement comme je vous dis tout à l'heure pro deux marques de passif.
[0] Donc le R c'est quoi ? Tout simplement, vous avez vu qu'il y a une zone qui se crée autour d'une personne qui a une marque.
[0] Alors c'est chiant, c'est pénible, il va vous we clear, c'est relou. Il se fait cap close, il est mort. Il se fait stun, il est mort, il se fait flan il est mort.

[0] Séraphine pareil, c'est Astropie. C'est les mêmes problèmes que les que les matches qu'il y a ici. C'est cool, c'est chiant machin, c'est pas grave. En mid game tempête de DPS de différence, vous allez lui mettre midame la premi elle est morte flan et cetera.
[1] very fun matchup because damage is quite even, try fight inside your minions so she doesnt get single target q and w on you, way less damage
[1] long range W into Ultimate and Q burst is super dangerous. Natural counter pick vs Ezreal.
[1] Do not let Kai'sa get her stacks. Wait for them to wear off before engaging. Stay behind minions in order to dodge her W.
[1] Ideal trades are ones where Kai'Sa can't hit proc her passive.
[1] Need to play around cooldowns and take shorts trades so she doesnt get passive off. If the fights is going long enough to proc her passive your probably losing.
[1] Most importantly fight her in your minions so she can't fully Q you, and try to dodge her W during fights, which might be difficult.
[1] She's paired with all in supports so she's kinda dangerous. She's bad into you late game.
[2] Pretty easy you can dodge every ability and outtrade her. She also has no mobility, so free gank setups for you.
[2] Very squishy especially early so dodge her poke and engage
[2] Her Beat Drop (E) can root or stun targets that are already slowed, and High Note (Q) allows her to consistently chip away at your health during lane.
[2] The lane becomes easier once Beat Drop (E) is used or misses. Without her primary crowd control available, Seraphine has fewer tools to stop your engage or protect herself during trades.
[2] If she misses the root on her passive empowered E or her ult you can all in her.
[2] She can easily catch you off guard. Her E slows you down for 99% and empowered E Roots you.

[2] Her Ult will travel farther and farther whenever it passes through any champion in the game so in front to back fights make sure to be ready for that and position yourself to not get hit or be ready to Flash it.
[2] She will be annoying if you let her scale for free, try to look for engage baiting her E so she doesnt stop you
